name: Kekkon Shitai Otoshigoro
source:
It's been a year since Yukari and her mother Rika moved into uncle Kazuma's house. Yukari is taken in by Kazuma's kindness, and ends up getting cajoled into sexual activity with him. Wanting to have Kazuma all to herself, Yukari starts to ramp up the sexual intensity.
